title: Trochlear Dysplasia Assessment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Assess the active tracking in sitting, looking for an abrupt lateral deviation near extension.
Assess the lateral glide at full extension and at thirty degrees, and note whether it falls as the knee flexes.
Ask about the age at first dislocation and about dislocations with minimal force, since both suggest a structural rather than a traumatic cause.
Ask about the other knee and about family history, since dysplasia is often bilateral.
